source: Exact source297 offline production catalog, no model/native HTTP dispatch

tools.name: operator_retrieve_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve a focused, byte-bounded selection from one named durable evidence item. Supply exactly one selector. Use targetSubset for exact target-bound rows; never use this to request all evidence. itemRange.count is 1..256; a page may contain fewer rows to fit its byte budget. Continue from result.pagination.next_start when has_more is true. Projected inventory.* count/fact keys can be retrieved directly, or use projection.key_counts.<key> / projection.key_facts.<key>. missing_fields distinguishes an absent field from an actual null value. For fields, result.selection uses the exact requested path as its key, such as selection['payload.elementIds']; itemRange returns the selected array directly. In Operator code mode, a successful JSON retrieval is one JSON object with optional host model_observation_index metadata; use JSON.parse(String(result)), then filter/map result.selection in that same cell before printing only needed facts. Projected itemRange rows wrap selected fields in row.values, with row_index and missing_fields. Do not truncate a JSON string and re-fetch the discarded rows; page using next_start instead. Inspect errors before parsing. Repeating an identical retrieval with a different purpose is still a repeat, not a parsing repair.

evidenceId.description: Named ev1_ evidence identity from a model-facing projection.

purpose.description: Specific decision or verification need; 'all evidence' is rejected.

fields.description: One or more typed paths. Mutually exclusive with itemRange, textRange, targetSubset, and image.

itemRange.description: One bounded retained array page. fields selects relative columns as row_index/values/missing_fields. Optional filters (1..8 AND predicates eq/ne/lt/lte/gt/gte over typed finite scalars) and orderBy (finite numeric asc/desc, missing/non-numeric last, stable source ties) require fields and at most5000 retained source rows. Non-null comparisons require matching scalar types; missing/nonfinite values never match. eq:null/ne:null test actual null/non-null scalars, not missing fields. These are discovery projections, always complete:false/source_rows_exhausted:false; original row_index remains the source index. With filters/orderBy, start/next_start count selected ranks; pagination.selection_query distinguishes original source, matches, unavailable values and selected_rows_exhausted. Bounds/source completeness do not certify native absence or work. Confirm selected targets with current native reads. Mutually exclusive with every other selector.

textRange.description: One bounded UTF-8 byte range. Mutually exclusive with every other selector.

targetSubset.description: Exact target identities; arbitrary prose and partial substrings never match. Mutually exclusive with every other selector.

image.description: Return one exact retained image as pixels with its original scope/hash, not base64 text or current-state proof. Mutually exclusive with every other selector.

maxBytes.description: Image: decoded file bytes, default/max5MiB. Text/JSON: existing default16KiB/max1MiB. Explicit smaller image budgets are respected.

tools.name: operator_manage_work_plan
tools.description: Manage the saved task checklist. The native checklist tracks requested model edits and their dependent inspections. A requested written follow-up belongs in the task result, not an unrequested model-edit item; actual unfinished requested design still needs defer with its specific question. Written findings do not certify native work or supply missing design decisions; existing checklist items cannot be removed to evade completion. Retain intermediate progress with checklist updates; propose_completion is a final user handoff that stops for review, not a context checkpoint. Continue ready independent work within current host limits; defer actual blockers with specific reasons. Default assignments require scope before multi-part edits and independently verified completion. In host-selected local advisory experiments planning is optional, complete records an unverified claim, and propose_completion submits bounded claimed_completed/remaining_work/uncertainties for independent review; each list has at most 24 entries and each entry at most 1000 characters. Put lengthy tables in a saved report artifact and reference it. Correct rejected report arguments without redoing model edits; this action cannot enable the experiment. Declare distinct room/system/branch items with their drawing/source basis and assumptions. Existing items cannot be removed or overwritten. Use dependsOn for ordered edits (delete a sheet before reusing its number). Cycles are rejected. Use defer with itemId/reason for an unresolved question; continue ready independent items and consolidate questions. resume_item with itemId/reason revisits a deferred item without marking it done. Status shows ready_items, waiting_on and deferrals; these are planning advice, not execution authority. Edit items require distinct independently verified native edits. Pre-change discovery stays outside dependent edit-inspection checklist items in strict mode; inspect project evidence before deciding which changes are justified. Do not invent model edits for the checklist. Use kind=inspection and dependsOn=[edit item IDs] for element/tag identity, loaded-family content, connectivity or copied-view reviews. Complete using fresh complete native operation IDs covering every dependent target after the latest edit: /revit/get-element-summary (exact IDs; tags require complete includeTagReferences:true), /revit/inspect-family-content (unfiltered loaded-family read), /revit/get-connectors, or the paired /revit/view-owned-detailing verification of duplicate-view withDetailing, or the accepted /revit/inspect-exported-files verification operation paired with the saved/exported artifact. File proof covers only exact artifact paths, never model elements or drawing completeness. An ordinary broad view-owned-detailing inventory cannot close another inspection; use scoped element and family reads instead. Child-family inspection does not prove loaded-project styling. Correct evidence arguments without repeating edits or asking the user to resolve a tool-contract problem. This records read coverage, not an engineering or visual pass. Later edits require fresh inspection. This records interpreted scope, not proof that the source drawing has been completely understood. Status restores the checklist after a restart. In advisory mode, checkpoint remaining_work and uncertainties are retained by exact text. update_followup records an UNVERIFIED resolved/deferred/superseded disposition with a reason for an existing item; deferred items stay visible. Superseded requires one to eight replacements with kind/text, retained atomically before proposing completion. Use the item identity/version returned by status and retain command_id on exact retries. This never certifies completion or changes write authority.

anyOf.description: Check desired stored category visibility, even if already correct with no edit. Optional sheet_ids require exact complete native /revit/sheets action=detail + includeViewportGeometry:true; host derives every placed model view. Also require a complete /revit/views includeTemplates:true census and fresh /revit/visibility action=get categoryName/includeCategoryState:true for each candidate, AFTER final edits and SaveAs. Omit operationIds for current-native-reference selection. Counts and controlling templates come from retained native bytes; this does not certify source interpretation, filtered/linked appearance, or unrelated-state preservation.

Check shared static family wording across the entire host category, including already-correct text. Call check_scope AFTER final edits, reloads and SaveAs. Omit operationIds for host selection: when complete current evidence is missing, the host performs one bounded read-only collection through normal ownership, pause, admission and settlement gates. It gathers a full unfiltered /revit/find-elements category census and unfiltered /revit/inspect-family-content per discovered type with maxElements:2000; no actor count or subset. Explicit references remain supported and must contain these complete fresh reads. expected_text is exact case/punctuation with whitespace normalized and must occur together in one static text object. An available wrong-text result is not automatically retried. Does not certify effective instance appearance, formatting/layout, labels, linked models or original source-comment completion.

scopeCheck.description: check_scope + existing itemId recomputes declared coverage from native bytes, never actor counts. Omit operationIds to let the host select matching current read references; explicit references remain supported. It retains unavailable attempts and never marks an item complete. Reads must start after the latest edit, including SaveAs. Tags: one complete document /revit/find-elements category census (only limit/includeGeometry extras); fresh Document.GetElement + OwnerViewId + HasLeader for candidates selected by view_ids/family_names. subject_family_names additionally needs complete GetTaggedLocalElements and subject Family readbacks. Category graphics: kind=category_graphics_v1, declared disciplines/view_types; one complete /revit/views list with includeTemplates:true, no filters except the exact disciplines and limit/offset0. Then /revit/visibility get with categoryName + includeCategoryState:true for EVERY matching non-template view. Category visibility: kind=category_visibility_v1 plus hidden:true/false; optional sheet_ids derives candidates from complete native sheet details with viewport geometry. Family static text: kind=family_static_text_v1 uses full host category census and fresh complete family content per discovered type. Already-correct states can be checked without edits. Host derives controlling template/property and excluded hidden views for halftone only. Does not prove hidden preservation, effective linked appearance, source interpretation or whole-item completion. Keep scope consistent; incomplete/changed evidence fails.

drafting.description: Optional source-linked drafting checkpoint. Use one meaningful branch/area per item, refining the plan as work proceeds; separate geometry/properties/connections/elevation/annotations/coverage passes. Requires source crop and native view. checked means an actor backcheck, not host certification: cite current native read operation IDs and distinct source/model image SHA256 values actually delivered in visual_inputs. Record drafted if not checked. Clean PDF reads automatically add the derived highlighted-reference overlay. Keep boundary connections and next useful action; no exhaustive inventory or per-element bookkeeping required.

locationHint.description: locate with itemId: persist source page/crop and candidate native view for restart. Keep unresolved/ambiguous locations explicit. Navigation hints never authorize edits or verify completion; native identity must be rechecked.

reason.description: For defer/resume_item only: specific unresolved question, blocker, or reason to revisit the item. Deferral is not completion.

user_facing_text.description: Concise final human-facing answer and requested written findings; include actual remaining requested work and meaningful limits. Keep checklist/evidence IDs and owner instructions in the technical lists. Unverified prose only, never native proof or completion authority.

operationIds.description: complete: reference the actual retained apply IDs for changes or saved artifacts. In advisory mode omit this field or use [] for already-correct work; this records an unverified claim, never native proof. Other actions require nonempty references when this field is supplied. check_scope is separate and never completes a checklist item.

tools.name: operator_evaluate_assignment_criteria
tools.description: Ask the V2 Assignment Kernel to evaluate stable criteria from cited Observation IDs and semantic facts. The runtime derives criterion status without model-authored pass/fail status. For a write task, first obtain independent native readback for the changed target, then cite its Observation IDs; omit resultItems and assessment. For a required read-result delivery only, select retained native values with resultItems; those presentation paths never determine criterion truth.

source.description: Default raw_payload selects native keys. deterministic_projection selects [key_counts or key_facts, exact literal key] recomputed from the same retained bytes. Complete inventory summaries only; no caller-provided values.

resultItems.description: Required only for a generic read's user-visible answer; omit for write tasks. Select exact concise values from retained native observations with arrays of object keys/array indexes. Values are extracted by the host; these presentation selectors cannot change semantic facts or criterion truth. Cover every requested answer before delivery.

overview.description: The complete user-facing answer in the requested length and format. Include every conclusion, material uncertainty and limitation needed to interpret it correctly. Usually one sentence for a simple question; do not add audit boilerplate or repeat supporting facts.

findings.description: At least one evidence-linked finding is required even when overview already contains the full answer. When all findings are low priority, supporting explanations and scope notes are collapsed in Details. Medium/high concerns remain expanded. Do not downgrade an actionable concern to shorten the answer.

assessment.description: For read-only audits, reviews, comparisons and gap lists, provide a useful assessment in addition to resultItems. Findings are assistant interpretations supported by 1-based evidence_indices into resultItems; they never establish native proof, engineering certification, criterion truth, authorization or supplied user inputs. State unverified limits and ask only the most useful outside-input questions. Select scalar resultItems or small scalar arrays, not whole reports. This structured delivery becomes the final answer; later free text cannot replace it.
